description: Test PR: article search endpoint + BlogSearch component, with planted issues.

expected.issue: SQL injection: q is interpolated into the query string
Pagination off by one: page 1 skips the first PAGE_SIZE results (should be (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE)
XSS: excerpt/query injected through dangerouslySetInnerHTML; query also used as an unescaped RegExp
Previous/Next are not bounded: page can go below 1 or past the last page

acceptable_extra: query not URL-encoded in the fetch URL
no debounce / stale responses can overwrite newer ones
